coachPreviewExpired: Plan proposal has expired; generate a fresh preview
assessmentInsufficient: The current evidence is not enough to judge today’s recovery reliably.
assessmentMissingFact: Current signals may differ from usual, but one key fact is missing.
assessmentSyncing: A material data source is still syncing; no action is needed from you yet.
assessmentAnswerIncluded: Your answer is included, but one more fact could change today’s recommendation.

today.insufficientEvidence: Some current evidence is temporarily unavailable. Keep activity low demand without increasing intensity or making up training; the advice will update when current evidence is available.
today.concern: Current recorded concerns take priority. Rest today and avoid starting an intense session; the existing coach decision can guide any further adjustment.
today.chosenRest: Keep today as your chosen rest day
today.chosenRestBody: Keep today for rest without making up training. Use your recent training load and plan to decide the next session tomorrow.
today.recoverBody: Your training feedback is recorded. Recover without making up training because a record is missing here; new activity data will update the recommendation.
today.keepConfirmed: Keep to the confirmed schedule conservatively
today.decisionUnavailable: The latest coach adjustments are temporarily unavailable. Keep to confirmed low-demand activity without adding or making up training.
today.memorySummary: Recent reports need to be considered with the current schedule. Avoid increasing intensity or making up training; keep today low demand until a complete judgment is available.
today.linkActivity: Training is recorded; check its workout association
today.linkActivityBody: This activity may correspond to {workouts}. It has not been automatically associated or used to mark a workout complete. Check the activity details and manually select the workout you completed; do not repeat training just because a workout is not checked off.
today.unapplied: The current schedule stands; the adjustment is not applied
today.unappliedBody: The proposed adjustment is not applied to your schedule. Follow the confirmed schedule without combining it with the alternative; accepting the adjustment will update the advice.
today.followScheduleBody: {workout} is scheduled today. Follow its prescribed content and intensity without adding volume; stop if pain or clear discomfort develops.
today.activityPresent: Activity is recorded; avoid repeating training
today.trainingPresent: Training is recorded; prioritize recovery next
today.activityPresentBody: Activity is recorded today, while {workout} is not marked complete. Do not automatically repeat or make up this session; activity processing and matching will update the advice.
today.recoveryNext: {activity}Avoid extra training for now; easy walking and gentle movement are enough if you want to stay active. {followUp}
today.easyBody: Keep to easy activity or rest for now, without adding intensity or squeezing in a session near the end of the day. Continue using recent load and your existing schedule.
today.processingBody: Activity data is still processing or syncing. This does not establish a missed workout or a need to make it up. Advice will update when processing finishes; no extra feedback is needed.
today.missingActivity: No recent training records are available
today.importOrCoach: There is no recorded activity to assess recent training yet. Import an activity or tell the coach about your available time and how you feel today.
today.importOnly: There is no recorded activity to assess recent training yet. Import an activity and check its processing status in your activity list.
today.staleActivity: No recent activities are recorded here; this does not imply you stopped training. Importing a recent activity can support advice based on your latest training.
today.continueSchedule: Continue with the existing schedule next.
today.unknownHistory: The available records do not establish your long-term training level or a training break.

reviewDemoSummary: Actual load {load}, included in the current training cycle.
